data.title: 诗怀雅 · 新茶试饮
data.description: 她尝了一口新茶，先说香气不错，又把另一杯推给你，等着听你的评价。
data.camera: 中近景，茶杯和桌面清晰
data.promptProse: Seated at a carved rosewood table in a private tea pavilion, Swire delicately raises a pale celadon cup of rare vintage oolong tea to her lips. A dark Yixing clay pot and an inscribed bamboo tea tray steam gently in the filtered daylight.
data.animaCaption: She takes a measured sip of the freshly steeped oolong, savoring the floral bouquet before passing a companion cup across the tray.
